freeze_statement: Author-defined illustration frozen after schema and metadata inspection and before computing case scores or group rankings; not an elicited or validated business norm.
scope_of_this_file: The application log of BPI Challenge 2017. The BPI Challenge 2012 application of the same configuration family is not part of this repository.
primary_reference: mean score of all scored applications under the selected view
rank_ties: Priority Index descending; number of scored cases descending; group key ascending
timestamp_policy: Parse timezone-aware ISO timestamps to UTC. The span needs at least two events and valid timestamps throughout. Count and breadth criteria do not depend on the order of events; no lifecycle interval pairing or handover sequence is inferred.
offer_identity: Distinct EventID on COMPLETE O_Create Offer; requires exact set equality with OfferID on COMPLETE O_Created, uniqueness of both lists, and every other O_ state OfferID belonging to that set.

C01.evidence: at least two events, every timestamp timezone-aware and valid
C01.meaning: long recorded span; not completed cycle time or a service-level breach

C02.evidence: all event activity and lifecycle values present
C02.meaning: sum over W_ activities of max(number of START records minus one, 0); excludes resume, suspend, schedule, complete, withdraw and ate_abort; not an estimate of necessary or unnecessary work time

C03.evidence: activity and lifecycle complete, every W_ START resource present; no starts yields an observed breadth of zero
C03.meaning: distinct recorded W_ START resource identifiers; no human or batch classification and no ownership assertion

C04.evidence: activity and lifecycle complete and fully reconciled creation identifiers and offer-state identifiers
C04.meaning: distinct observed offers associated with an application; legitimate options may create multiple offers

C05.evidence: all event activity and lifecycle values present
C05.meaning: number of COMPLETE A_Incomplete state records; an information follow-up indicator, not a control violation or inferred cause

limits: No costs, causes, savings, loan risk, service-level or completion judgments.
Cancellation, refusal and decline are not penalised.
Resource and offer counts do not establish staffing cost or defective work.
